prompt: A metal block slides across a rough concrete floor and eventually comes to rest. State the primary energy transformation that takes place during this deceleration.

mark_scheme.criterion: is converted into internal thermal energy (heat) of the block and the floor (and sound).

hints: What form of energy does the moving block possess initially?
What happens to the temperature of the block and floor as it slides to a halt?
solution: Kinetic energy of the block is transformed into internal thermal energy of the block and floor (and sound).
teacher_walkthrough: Final form: internal energy / thermal energy of surfaces (B1).
Work done against friction dissipates mechanical energy into microscopic thermal vibrations.
